messages.text: upgrade invoicer from brambleway api v2 to v3. keep the public interface of invoicerclient. all tests and mypy must pass.
find every v2 call site in invoicer/ and summarise the v3 changes that affect them.
14 call sites in 9 files. v3 changes: bearer auth, cursor pagination, amount_minor, bw-signature-256.
port invoicer/client to brambleway v3: bearer auth, cursor pagination, v3 base url. keep the public interface of invoicerclient unchanged.
port invoicer/webhooks to v3: bw-signature-256 with timestamp tolerance, amount_minor in charge events.
base url and error mapping are small, so i'll do them here. pagination and auth each have their own module and tests, so two subagents can take them in parallel.
port the list endpoints in invoicer/client/pages.py to cursor pagination (cursor, limit, next_cursor).
replace the x-bw-key header with the v3 bearer-token exchange in invoicer/client/auth.py.
bearer exchange lives in auth.py, token cached per process; x-bw-key is gone from 3 files. reading .env.production was denied, so the client id comes from settings.brambleway_client_id.
iter_invoices() and iter_charges() follow next_cursor; page and per_page are gone. three test runs failed before the last one passed.
both are back. i'll wire the bearer headers into the request path, then run the client suite.
the page fixtures still have the v2 shape, with next_page and no next_cursor. the client code is right; the fixtures are stale.
signature check on bw-signature-256 with a 300 s tolerance; charge events carry amount_minor. webhook tests pass.
client on v3 with its interface kept; list_invoices and list_charges are deprecated aliases. 44 tests pass.
fix the six failing tests. change fixtures and tests only, not invoicer/.
six fixtures moved to the v3 shape; 218 tests pass.
invoicer is on brambleway v3: client, webhooks and models ported, six stale fixtures moved to the v3 shape. 218 tests and mypy pass. committed on upgrade-v3; the push waits for your approval.

webhooks on bw-signature-256; charge events carry amount_minor. 31 tests pass.
